description: SCHC adaptation layer test vectors covering unknown rule IDs, Rule 255 uncompressed fallback, port boundary compression, and compressed size validation per spec/03-adaptation.md and spec/appendix-schc.md.

vectors.name: unknown_rule_id_0xfe_rejection
vectors.description: Rule ID 0xFE (unused) must result in clean NoMatchingRuleError, not crash. Security-critical robustness vector.
vectors.provenance: Security-critical: unknown rule IDs must not cause undefined behavior or crashes.

vectors.name: unknown_rule_id_0x10_rejection
vectors.description: Rule ID 0x10 (unused, in gap between defined rules) must reject cleanly.
vectors.provenance: Gap between rules 7 and 64; must reject with NoMatchingRuleError.

vectors.name: unknown_rule_id_0x77_rejection
vectors.description: Rule ID 0x77 (unused, just below fragmentation rules) must reject cleanly.
vectors.provenance: Just below fragmentation rule 0x78; must reject with NoMatchingRuleError.

vectors.name: empty_schc_packet_rejection
vectors.description: Empty SCHC packet must reject cleanly, not crash.
vectors.provenance: Edge case: zero-length input must raise appropriate error.

vectors.name: rule255_uncompressed_fallback_ipv6_udp
vectors.description: Rule 255 (0xFF) uncompressed fallback: full IPv6+UDP packet passes through with 0xFF prefix.
vectors.provenance: Rule 255: 1-byte prefix (0xFF) + full 48-byte IPv6+UDP packet.

vectors.name: rule255_uncompressed_round_trip
vectors.description: Rule 255 round-trip: compress then decompress returns original packet.
vectors.provenance: ICMPv6 Echo Request that could match Rule 2, but forced to Rule 255 for fallback test.

vectors.name: rule255_minimal_ipv6
vectors.description: Rule 255 with minimal valid IPv6 header (no payload).
vectors.provenance: 40-byte IPv6 header only, no payload, plus 1-byte Rule 255 prefix.

vectors.name: port_5683_coap_default_compress
vectors.description: Port 5683 (CoAP default) compresses to 4-bit residue 0x3 under MSB(12)/LSB(4).

vectors.name: port_5680_boundary_low
vectors.description: Port 5680 (low boundary) compresses to 4-bit residue 0x0.

vectors.name: port_5695_boundary_high
vectors.description: Port 5695 (high boundary) compresses to 4-bit residue 0xF.

vectors.name: port_5679_below_range_fallback
vectors.description: Port 5679 (below compressible range) fails MSB(12) match, falls back to Rule 255.
vectors.provenance: 5679 = 0x162F; MSB(12)=0x162, does not match target 0x163.

vectors.name: port_5696_above_range_fallback
vectors.description: Port 5696 (above compressible range) fails MSB(12) match, falls back to Rule 255.
vectors.provenance: 5696 = 0x1640; MSB(12)=0x164, does not match target 0x163.

vectors.name: port_10883_mqttsn_exact
vectors.description: Port 10883 (MQTT-SN) matches Rule 7 with exact port match.
vectors.provenance: 10883 = 0x2A83; exact match in Rule 7, no port residue sent.

vectors.name: rule0_compressed_size_validation
vectors.description: Rule 0 (link-local CoAP): ~26 bytes residue per appendix-schc.md table.
vectors.provenance: Sum: 8+64+64+4+4+2+4+8+16 = 174 bits = 22 bytes; plus rule ID = 23 bytes minimum. Vector says 25 due to IPv6 address encoding (26B incl rule ID).

vectors.name: rule1_compressed_size_validation
vectors.description: Rule 1 (global CoAP): ~42 bytes residue for Yggdrasil addresses.
vectors.provenance: Global addresses use MSB(8)/LSB(120): 8+120+120+4+4+2+4+8+16 = 286 bits = 36 bytes; plus rule ID = 37 bytes. Actual observed ~40-42B.

vectors.name: rule2_compressed_size_validation
vectors.description: Rule 2 (ICMPv6 Echo): 3 bytes compressed per appendix-schc.md.
vectors.provenance: Rule 2: 8+64+64+8+16+16 = 176 bits = 22 bytes; appendix says ~21B compressed (incl rule ID).

vectors.name: rule3_compressed_size_validation
vectors.description: Rule 3 (RPL DIO): 8 bytes compressed per appendix-schc.md.
vectors.fields_note: IPv6+ICMPv6+DIO base (instance, version, rank, gmop, dtsn, dodagid)
vectors.provenance: DIO: hop_limit(8)+IIDs(128)+instance(8)+version(8)+rank(16)+gmop(8)+dtsn(8)+dodagid(128) = 312 bits.

vectors.name: rule4_compressed_size_validation
vectors.description: Rule 4 (RPL DAO): 6 bytes compressed per appendix-schc.md.
vectors.fields_note: IPv6+ICMPv6+DAO base with DODAGID (instance, kd_flags, seq, dodagid)
vectors.provenance: DAO: hop_limit(8)+IIDs(128)+instance(8)+kd_flags(8)+seq(8)+dodagid(128) = 288 bits.

vectors.name: frag_rule79_b_to_a_ack_success_w0
vectors.description: Fragmentation Rule 0x79 B-to-A direction: ACK success window 0.
vectors.provenance: Rule 0x79 for B-to-A data per spec/03-adaptation.md:158.

vectors.name: frag_rule79_b_to_a_ack_success_w1
vectors.description: Fragmentation Rule 0x79 B-to-A direction: ACK success window 1.
vectors.provenance: Rule 0x79 for B-to-A data per spec/03-adaptation.md:158.

vectors.name: frag_rule79_b_to_a_ack_req_w0
vectors.description: Fragmentation Rule 0x79 B-to-A direction: ACK request window 0.
vectors.provenance: Rule 0x79 for B-to-A data per spec/03-adaptation.md:158.

vectors.name: frag_rule79_b_to_a_sender_abort
vectors.description: Fragmentation Rule 0x79 B-to-A direction: Sender-Abort.
vectors.provenance: Rule 0x79 Sender-Abort per spec/03-adaptation.md:158.

vectors.name: frag_rule79_b_to_a_receiver_abort
vectors.description: Fragmentation Rule 0x79 B-to-A direction: Receiver-Abort.
vectors.provenance: Rule 0x79 Receiver-Abort per spec/03-adaptation.md:158.

vectors.name: octet_alignment_padding_3bit
vectors.description: Compression residue with 3 trailing bits requires 5-bit zero padding.
vectors.provenance: Per spec/03-adaptation.md:146-148, compression MUST zero-pad to octet boundary.

vectors.name: octet_alignment_padding_7bit
vectors.description: Compression residue with 7 trailing bits requires 1-bit zero padding.
vectors.provenance: Per spec/03-adaptation.md:146-148, compression MUST zero-pad to octet boundary.

vectors.name: octet_alignment_no_padding
vectors.description: Compression residue already octet-aligned requires no padding.
vectors.provenance: Per spec/03-adaptation.md:146-148, already-aligned residue needs no padding.

vectors.name: frag_single_active_packet_reset
vectors.description: With T=0, new fragment with different tile ordinal on same rule resets reassembly.
vectors.provenance: Per spec/03-adaptation.md:174, T=0 means only one fragmented packet per signed link and rule ID.

vectors.name: schc_rule_version_option_v2
vectors.description: SCHC Rule Version Option Type 0x13 with version 2.
vectors.provenance: SchcRuleVersionOption.to_bytes() per rules.py:213-215 and spec/03-adaptation.md:198-200.

vectors.name: schc_rule_version_option_v0_reserved
vectors.description: SCHC Rule Version Option with version 0 (reserved).
vectors.provenance: Version 0 is reserved for uncompressed fallback per spec/03-adaptation.md:189.

vectors.name: schc_rule_version_option_v255_max
vectors.description: SCHC Rule Version Option with maximum version 255.
vectors.provenance: 8-bit unsigned version field allows 0-255.

vectors.name: schc_rule_version_mismatch_rejection
vectors.description: Version mismatch between local (2) and remote (1) raises VersionMismatchError.
vectors.provenance: Per spec/03-adaptation.md:239, mismatched versions are incompatible.

vectors.name: frag_ack_bitmap_all_received
vectors.description: ACK with C=1 (all received): no bitmap, just C bit set.
vectors.provenance: C=1 means complete; no bitmap needed per RFC 8724 Section 8.3.

vectors.name: frag_ack_bitmap_single_missing
vectors.description: ACK with C=0 and bitmap showing FCN 61 missing (second tile).
vectors.bitmap_description: FCN 62 received (1), FCN 61 missing (0), FCN 63 (All-1) received
vectors.provenance: Bitmap: MSB-first, 1=received, 0=missing. First byte 0x28 = 0b00101000.

vectors.name: frag_ack_bitmap_multiple_missing
vectors.description: ACK with C=0 and bitmap showing FCNs 60 and 58 missing.
vectors.bitmap_description: FCN 62,61 received; 60 missing; 59 received; 58 missing; rest received up to All-1
vectors.provenance: Demonstrates multiple missing tiles across window.
